title: WorldMap Component Schema
description: All WorldMap custom recognition parameter definitions. Referenced by custom.recognition.schema.json.

MapFindParam.description: Parameters for MapFind: work out where the open world map is currently showing, bring the given base map coordinate into view, and hand back the screen position it landed on. What to do with that position is the node's own action.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Zone name, i.e. the directory name under assets/resource/image/MapLocator/.

at.title: At
at.description: The point to find, [x, y] in that zone's base map pixel frame. Use candidates instead to judge several points in one call.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Several points judged in one call, in writing order. They share a single zoom-out and a single viewport solve, and the map is only panned for a candidate that is not already on screen, so a set of points costs far less here than one node per point. The first candidate whose icon confirms hands its own next back to the framework and the rest are never looked at. A candidate whose next node is turned off with enabled false is skipped without being looked at, which is how a task option turns one destination off and leaves the others to be judged. Requires an icon: coordinates alone cannot tell candidates apart, so every candidate would confirm.

at.title: At
at.description: The point to find, [x, y] in that zone's base map pixel frame.

next.title: Next
next.description: Node the framework goes to when this candidate is the one confirmed. It also owns the candidate's on/off switch: turning this node off with enabled false skips the candidate entirely.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Name of an entry in assets/resource/image/SceneManager/MapIcons.json. The templates and every threshold that goes with them live in that table, so a new kind of icon is a table entry rather than a set of node parameters. Omit it to only solve the coordinate, confirming no icon at all.

state.title: State
state.description: Which unlock state counts as a hit. Requires an icon whose table entry carries gold_ratio, since that is what tells the two states apart. Optional, defaults to unlocked.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Recognition attempts. Panning the map is not charged against it. Optional, defaults to 4.

vote_grid.title: Vote Grid
vote_grid.description: Fallback for when matching the whole search window at once cannot solve the viewport. The window is split into vote_grid x vote_grid blocks matched separately and combined by a per-pixel median, so a locally occluded block gets outvoted instead of dragging the whole frame's score down. It only runs after the whole-window attempt has already been rejected, so a frame that solves normally is unaffected. Set to 1 to turn the fallback off for this node. Optional, defaults to 3.
